notebook_76.name: fnspid_development_negative_share_double_sort
notebook_76.first_sort: within-session mean_continuous quintiles using deterministic average-tie percentile ranks
notebook_76.second_sort: within each session and mean-sentiment quintile, form negative-share terciles with fractional allocation of tied values; each tercile receives exactly one third of the cell weight and no arbitrary symbol tie-break is used
notebook_76.contrast: equal-weight high-minus-low next-open return inside each mean-sentiment quintile, then equal-weight the available quintile spreads within each session
samples: predeclared descriptive sensitivity restricted to n >= 2 stories
notebook_76.inference: HAC(5) interval on the daily spread series; no cross-sectional regression
notebook_76.design_change_log: The initially declared absolute <=1/3 and >=2/3 negative-share buckets produced no session with three overlapping mean-sentiment quintiles and execution stopped before any spread estimate was computed. The tie-aware dependent-tercile rule was recorded next because it is the standard double-sort estimand and preserves all ties without outcome-based choices.
